subject.title: Claude CLI default model cannot move: session-creation probe is pinned to one hardcoded model id

question: Should Claude CLI session creation select a configured routed model independently of the canonical default, and what precedence should apply when an agent has more than one eligible Claude CLI route?
rationale: The source-reported fix is bounded, but model choice becomes observable session behavior when multiple configured routes qualify; maintainer intent is needed to establish the durable selection contract before implementation.

options.title: Define route-aware discovery
options.body: Prefer the canonical default when it is explicitly routed for the requested agent, otherwise select a documented deterministic eligible Claude CLI route.

options.title: Keep default-bound probing
options.body: Do not change resolver behavior and require a migration whenever the canonical Claude CLI model changes.

options.title: Defer the default-model move
options.body: Keep current probing and leave the Claude CLI default pinned until a broader routing-policy decision is made.

recommendation.title: Define route-aware discovery
recommendation.body: Prefer the canonical default when it is explicitly routed for the requested agent, otherwise select a documented deterministic eligible Claude CLI route.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete regression analysis and recently merged the surrounding Opus 5 model support while explicitly preserving this boundary.
